**Given:** The manifolds, collars, framed embeddings and boundary identifications in the Statement; AC ([[def-axiom-of-choice]]).

[F1] [[thm-relative-whitney-approximation-for-manifold-valued-maps]] smooths a homotopy relative to a neighborhood of its stationary endpoints. The actual proof of [[thm-whitney-approximation-for-manifold-valued-maps]] supplies a finite-dimensional Euclidean embedding of the target and a smooth neighborhood retraction; those constructed data are used below.

[F2] [[thm-parametric-transversality]] gives a null set of bad parameters when the full finite-dimensional evaluation is transverse. The polynomial interpolation used to make that evaluation submersive is proved below.

[F3] [[lem-a-smooth-isotopy-of-compact-embedded-submanifolds-extends-to-an-ambient-isotopy]] extends compact circle isotopies with prescribed neighborhood support. [[lem-isotopy-extension-for-a-compact-source-with-boundary]] applies to compact full-dimensional tubular product embeddings with boundary in the boundaryless interior. [[thm-compactly-supported-time-dependent-vector-fields-have-global-evolution-on-a-compact-time-interval]] gives their supported smooth ambient flows.

[F4] [[thm-seifert-van-kampen]] identifies the group of a handle attachment as the pushout of the old stage and a contractible handle over the connected attaching region.

[F5] [[lem-a-normal-summand-of-rank-at-least-two-surjects-on-the-framing-loop-obstruction]] states that $SO(2)	o SO(3)$ surjects on fundamental groups and proves it by a Stiefel disk filling and complement-frame transport. [[thm-collar-neighborhood-theorem]] supplies the collars used to push auxiliary homotopies into the interior.

**Given:** The manifolds, collars, framed embeddings and boundary identifications in the Statement; AC ([[def-axiom-of-choice]]).

[F1] [[lem-isotopy-extension-for-a-compact-source-with-boundary]] compares isotopies of the full compact tubular attaching embeddings; [[lem-smooth-handle-attachment-is-independent-of-corner-rounding-up-to-diffeomorphism]] compares compatible seam roundings by collar-supported diffeomorphisms.

[F2] [[lem-framed-circles-in-four-dimensional-two-handle-traces-move-to-the-base]] moves an interior framed circle of a four-dimensional two-handle trace to a pushed-in fixed base, disjoint from the old link, retaining the prescribed rank-three framing through an integral level framing.

[F3] [[lem-circumcision-meridian-pair-preserves-relative-three-manifold]] gives the actual boundary-relative solid-torus diffeomorphism for a framed core and its disk-framed zero meridian. It fixes the old link and external collars when their supports avoid that torus.

[F4] [[lem-boundary-connected-sum-with-a-disk-does-not-change-the-diffeomorphism-type]] absorbs a ball attached along a boundary disk by a diffeomorphism supported in its collar.

**Given:** The manifolds, collars, framed embeddings and boundary identifications in the Statement; AC ([[def-axiom-of-choice]]).

[F1] [[thm-adapted-excellent-morse-functions-exist-on-compact-cobordisms]] gives the actual bump-supported finite differential-perturbation and local metric construction for compact ordinary triads. [[thm-parametric-transversality]] gives the finite-dimensional perturbation theorem. The vertical-face adaptation is constructed below, not presumed from the ordinary-triad statement.

[F2] [[thm-every-smooth-manifold-admits-a-riemannian-metric]], [[thm-smooth-partitions-of-unity-exist-on-manifolds-with-boundary]], and [[lem-manifold-bump-for-a-compact-set-inside-an-open-set]] supply metrics and supported patching. [[thm-compactly-supported-time-dependent-vector-fields-have-global-evolution-on-a-compact-time-interval]] and [[thm-fundamental-theorem-on-flows]] give complete supported flows and uniqueness.

[F3] [[lem-handles-of-equal-index-can-be-attached-on-one-level]] supplies the local framed handle-band construction and isotopy invariance. [[lem-smooth-handle-attachment-is-independent-of-corner-rounding-up-to-diffeomorphism]] supplies relative seam rounding.

[F4] [[lem-gradient-like-perturbation-separates-adjacent-critical-levels]] supplies the interior crossing-sphere moving-off construction. [[lem-critical-values-of-disjoint-trajectory-closures-can-be-interchanged]] supplies its actual orbit-constant separating function and value-change formula. Their fixed-vertical-height extension is supplied below.

[F5] [[prop-connected-cobordisms-admit-presentations-without-superfluous-zero-handles]] proves zero-handle removal by a rooted spanning tree and transport of later attaching maps. [[lem-boundary-connected-sum-with-a-disk-does-not-change-the-diffeomorphism-type]] supplies its collar-supported disk absorption. Below this construction is carried out away from the vertical collar.

**Given:** The manifolds, collars, framed embeddings and boundary identifications in the Statement; AC ([[def-axiom-of-choice]]).

[F1] [[thm-every-closed-oriented-smooth-three-manifold-bounds-a-compact-oriented-smooth-four-manifold]] supplies a compact oriented smooth four-dimensional filling of every actual closed oriented three-manifold, retaining its marked cap submanifolds by the boundary identification.

[F2] [[lem-fixed-vertical-height-relative-morse-handle-normalization]] gives fixed-vertical-height relative handles and, for connected nonempty ends and connected total bordism, a presentation with no zero or top handles. [[lem-interior-one-handle-trade-and-framed-circle-surgery-pair]] changes an interior one-handle into a two-handle in dimension four while preserving the full boundary.

[F3] [[lem-framed-circles-in-four-dimensional-two-handle-traces-move-to-the-base]] supplies an explicit value/first-jet submersive polynomial family for perturbing curves in a three-manifold, including avoidance of any prescribed finite link. [[lem-isotopy-extension-for-a-compact-source-with-boundary]] compares full attaching-thickening isotopies relative to the incoming boundary.

[F4] [[thm-collar-neighborhood-theorem]] supplies smooth collars and [[lem-smooth-handle-attachment-is-independent-of-corner-rounding-up-to-diffeomorphism]] supplies collar-supported compatible seam roundings.

**Given:** The manifolds, collars, framed embeddings and boundary identifications in the Statement; AC ([[def-axiom-of-choice]]).

[F1] [[lem-fixed-vertical-height-relative-morse-handle-normalization]] supplies the fixed-height cornered relative handle presentation, top/zero deletion and index ordering for connected nonempty ends.

[F2] [[lem-interior-one-handle-trade-and-framed-circle-surgery-pair]] gives the boundary-preserving one-to-three trade in dimension five and the actual four-dimensional framed-circle-surgery two-handle pair.

[F3] [[lem-framed-circles-in-four-dimensional-two-handle-traces-move-to-the-base]] moves every attaching framed circle in a four-dimensional two-handle trace into its fixed base avoiding the old attaching link, for arbitrary fundamental-group class and prescribed full framing.

[F4] [[lem-circumcision-meridian-pair-preserves-relative-three-manifold]] gives the boundary-relative O3 identification, fixing every old attaching link outside its small solid torus. [[lem-projective-plane-stabilization-gives-relative-five-bordisms]] supplies the actual connected fixed-collar five-bordism after split signed unit-framed-unknot insertions.
